label: X-01
evidence: crates/sealmap-corpus/src/seal/sign.rs:11-12 (Signature 'recorded as given; sealmap applies no policy to reviewer or model'), sign.rs:107-111 (only non-empty/date checks); seal/mod.rs:29-30 ('reviewer and model are opaque strings'); docs/DESIGN.md:123-124 ('Reviewer family, evidence and signatures are skill policy, enforced by seal-gate.mjs next to verify. That keeps the crate estate-neutral').
rationale: The mechanics are described accurately, but this is an explicit, documented design decision: the crate never claims tamper resistance or identity binding and delegates signature policy to an external gate. It is not a defect at this revision.

label: X-02
evidence: crates/sealmap-corpus/src/contract.rs:125-127 (a non-UTF-8 file is left out of `actual`); contract.rs:80-82 (an expected path missing from `actual` is reported as Drift::Missing); contract.rs:142-156 (write rewrites Missing entries with fs::write, overwriting the corrupt file).
rationale: An expected document that is not valid UTF-8 is classed as Missing, so verify fails and write overwrites it. Only non-expected, non-UTF-8 files are skipped, which is harmless. The claimed permanent blind spot does not exist.

label: X-03
evidence: crates/sealmap-rust/src/layout.rs:40-60 (packages keyed by the Cargo.toml name, no repository component, no duplicate-name check), layout.rs:88-112 (module = [pkg.name,...]); crates/sealmap/src/lib.rs:123-134 (load_repos prefixes file paths only); crates/sealmap-model/src/codebase.rs:66-87 (add_symbol merges same-id symbols, keeping the first symbol's scalar fields such as file and flow); crates/sealmap-corpus/src/naming.rs:23-30 (assert only fires when two different ids map to the same ident).
rationale: In multi-repo mode, two repositories that each contain a crate with the same name produce identical sym: ids. Their symbols are silently merged and no diagnostic is raised. The core defect is real, though the cross-repo call-edge consequence was not reproduced.

label: X-04
